notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Myr Welder by tapping it, exiling Staff of Domination from your graveyard.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder by tapping it, exiling Palladium Myr from your graveyard.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Palladium Myr's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4.
